title: Health Reminder for Flu Season
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
COMMUNITY 

INFORMATION

COMMUNITY INFORMATION

HEALTH AND WELLNESS
Health Reminder: Flu and Seasonal IllnessWe are seeing an increase in flu and seasonal illnesses at school. To help prevent the spread ofillness, please keep your child home if they have a fever (100°F or higher), vomiting or diarrhea,significant cough, sore throat with fever, body aches, extreme fatigue, or flu-like symptoms.Students should be fever-free for 24 hours without medication and symptom-free for 24 hoursafter vomiting or diarrhea before returning to school. Thank you for helping keep our schoolcommunity healthy.

summary: **Flu and seasonal illnesses are increasing at school.** Please keep students home if they have a fever (100°F or higher), vomiting, diarrhea, significant cough, sore throat with fever, body aches, extreme fatigue, or flu-like symptoms. Students must be **fever-free for 24 hours without medication** and **symptom-free for 24 hours** after vomiting or diarrhea before returning to school.

summary:
The Talawanda School District provides multiple food resources for families in need:
- **Little Free Pantries** are available 24/7 outside every TSD building, restocked weekly
- **Backpack Program** provides weekly food bags on Thursdays/Fridays at elementary buildings (contact building Social Worker)
- **Emergency Food boxes** available for pick-up or delivery within 24 hours
- Resources include a [calendar of community meals and TOPPS schedule](link), [list of all Butler County food pantries](link), and [SNAP information](link)

summary:
**Talawanda School District** offers multiple food assistance programs for families in need:

title: Little Women Musical Performance at THS
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content: This family friendly Broadway musical features the heartwarming 1868 story by Louisa May Alcott of the 4 March sisters as they navigate life during the Civil War, the trials of becoming individuals, and their pursuits for happiness in very different circumstances. The production features performances and tech work of close to 20 THS students from all class levels, with many contributions from Oxford community members. Tickets may be purchased at this LINK or with cash at the door.

summary: **Little Women: The Musical** will be performed by Talawanda High School Drama Club at the THS Performing Arts Center. This family-friendly Broadway musical tells Louisa May Alcott's 1868 story of the March sisters during the Civil War. Shows are **December 5th at 7 PM**, **December 6th at 2 PM and 7 PM**. Tickets are **$8** and can be purchased [online](https://www.talawanda.org) or with cash at the door. Nearly 20 THS students from all grades participate, with contributions from Oxford community members.
